fullDescription: A warm, magazine-style 3-tier SaaS pricing page on cream paper with oversized serif type, terracotta accents, a monthly/annual pill toggle, and a single inverted dark 'Popular' tier.
prompt:
## Resumo A warm, editorial premium SaaS pricing page in a 3-tier card layout on a cream/paper background, anchored by oversized serif display type and a single high-contrast 'dark card' middle tier. The transferable value is the look: a magazine-quality, low-saturation 'old-money'/atelier aesthetic (Fraunces + Newsreader serifs over an Inter UI), terracotta/clay/sage accents on warm off-white, soft rounded cards, a pill monthly/annual toggle, and a clean accordion FAQ. Copy this to get a refined, non-techy pricing page where the structure (free Solo / highlighted Studio / per-seat team Atelier) and the editorial styling do the selling. ## Estilo Visual Build a warm editorial / 'atelier' premium aesthetic. Exact palette (use these hex): background paper #f7f3ec, card/surface cream #fbf8f2, primary text + dark elements 'ink' #1c1a17, hairline border 'line' #e4ddd0, plus three accents: clay #a8612f (badges, free-tier checkmarks, eyebrow labels), terra/terracotta #c0673a (primary CTA, 'Popular' badge, highlighted-tier checks), and muted sage #5a6b54 ('save' note + team-tier checks). Fonts (Google Fonts): display serif 'Fraunces' (optical sizing, weight 300-600) for all headings and price numerals; reading serif 'Newsreader' for tier descriptions, FAQ questions/answers and the italic guarantee line; 'Inter' (400/450/500/600) for nav, labels, buttons and uppercase eyebrows. Treatments: subtle 'grain' overlay made of two faint radial-gradients (terracotta at ~6% top-left, sage at ~7% top-right) over hero and pricing; uppercase eyebrow/section labels with wide letter-spacing (~0.28em) in clay; price numerals use tabular-nums; cards are rounded-2xl with 1px warm 'line' borders and a soft long-shadow on hover; buttons are full pill shapes; antialiased, optimizeLegibility. Keep saturation low and the mood calm, expensive and print-like, never neon or techy. ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky top nav Sticky top header (sticky top-0, z-50) on a translucent paper background with backdrop-blur and a hairline bottom 'line' border. Left: a brand lockup of a small ink-filled circle holding a cream asterisk glyph next to the wordmark 'Atelier' in the display serif. Center (hidden below lg): inline text nav links in Inter at ~13.5px, muted ink/70 -> ink on hover: Library, Showcase, Pricing (active), FAQ, Changelog. Right: a muted 'Sign in' text link plus a solid ink pill button 'Start free' (cream text) that lifts slightly on hover. Inner nav uses max-w-6xl with horizontal padding. ### Hero / headline + toggle Centered hero (max-w-3xl) over the grain background. Top: a pill 'eyebrow' badge with a sparkle icon, uppercase wide-tracked clay text reading 'CURATED PROMPT LIBRARY', on a cream fill with a line border. Then a very large display-serif headline (~text-5xl up to text-7xl) with tight leading (~0.98) and an optional
mid-phrase, e.g. 'Plans for every kind of maker.' Below: a reading-serif subhead (~text-lg/xl, ink/70) one or two sentences describing who the tiers are for (solo builder to studios at scale). Below that: a centered monthly/annual selector (see special components) with a small sage 'Save two months' note + a bent-arrow icon to its right (hidden on small screens). ### Pricing grid (the core) Three-tier pricing grid inside max-w-6xl: grid-cols-1 on mobile -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3, items-stretch, gap ~5-6, with the grain background continuing. Tiers, left to right: (1) 'Solo' — free tier on a cream card with line border; price shows a giant serif '$0' with an uppercase 'FREE, FOREVER' caption; outline/ghost pill CTA 'Start building' that fills ink on hover; an 'Includes' label then a checklist (clay checkmarks) of ~5 features (e.g. 200 curated prompts, personal collections, web app canvas access, copy to any coding agent, community gallery). (2) 'Studio' — the highlighted/popular tier rendered as a SOLID DARK 'ink' card with cream text, lifted slightly on large screens (negative top margin) and a stronger shadow; a terracotta 'POPULAR' pill badge with a star pinned top-right; giant serif price ('$24') with a stacked 'USD / per mo, billed yearly' caption and a sub-note '$288 billed once a year'; a solid terracotta primary CTA 'Choose Studio'; an 'Everything in Solo, plus' label then ~6 features with terracotta checkmarks (full 4,000+ prompt library, unlimited generations, editable source files, private collections & sharing, weekly drops, priority rendering queue). (3) 'Atelier' — team/enterprise tier, cream card with line border, giant serif price ('$79') with 'USD / per mo, billed yearly' caption and 'Per seat, 3 seats minimum' sub-note; outline pill CTA 'Talk to us'; an 'Everything in Studio, plus' label then ~5 features with sage checkmarks (shared team workspace, brand-tuned prompt packs, SSO & role permissions, usage analytics dashboard, dedicated success partner). Each card is flex-col with the feature list pushed to the bottom (mt-auto) so the three cards align. Below the grid, a centered italic reading-serif reassurance line, e.g. 'Every plan includes a 14-day window to switch or step down, no questions asked.' ### FAQ accordion FAQ section on a cream background with a top hairline border, max-w-4xl, generously padded. Centered header: a small uppercase clay 'QUESTIONS' eyebrow above a display-serif heading 'Before you decide' (~text-4xl/5xl). Below: a vertical stack of native
/ accordion rows divided by hairline 'line' borders (top & bottom border too). Each summary shows the question in the reading serif (~text-lg/xl) with a right-aligned plus icon (ink/50) that rotates 45deg to an 'x' when open; the answer is reading serif at ~15.5px, ink/65, max-w-2xl. First item open by default. ~4 questions covering plan switching/proration, what a 'generation' is, whether prompts work inside coding agents (Claude Code / Cursor), and the annual-billing discount. ### Footer Footer on paper background with a top hairline border, max-w-6xl. Top row (stacks on mobile, row on md): left a brand block repeating the circle-asterisk logo + 'Atelier' wordmark and a one-line reading-serif tagline ('A curated prompt library for designers and builders who want shippable UI, faster.'); right a 2-3 column link grid with uppercase muted column headers (Product / Company / Support) and Inter link lists in ink/65 -> ink on hover. Bottom strip separated by a hairline border: left a small copyright line ('© 2026 Atelier Studio. All rights reserved.'), right inline Privacy / Terms / Twitter links, ~12.5px ink/45. ## Componentes Especiais de UI ### Monthly / Annual pill toggle — A two-segment pill switch centered under the hero that swaps the price numerals and billing captions on the paid tiers. An inline pill toggle: a rounded-full cream container with a line border and small shadow holding two pill buttons, 'Monthly' and 'Annual'. The active segment is a solid ink pill with cream text and a subtle shadow; the inactive segment is muted ink/55 text on transparent. Default to Annual selected. Wire it with a tiny script: Annual shows Studio '$24 /mo, billed yearly' + '$288 billed once a year' and Atelier '$79 /mo, billed yearly'; Monthly shows Studio '$29 /mo' + 'Billed monthly' and Atelier '$95 /mo'. To the right, a sage 'Save two months' helper with a bent-down-left arrow icon, hidden on small screens. ### Highlighted dark 'Popular' tier card — The middle pricing tier inverted to a solid dark card to anchor the eye and steer the choice. Render the recommended (middle) tier as a solid ink #1c1a17 card with cream text instead of the cream card used by its siblings, give it a deep soft shadow and lift it slightly above the others on large screens (small negative top/bottom margin so it overhangs the grid). Pin a small terracotta #c0673a rounded-full 'POPULAR' badge with a star icon to its top-right corner. Use terracotta checkmarks and a solid terracotta primary CTA inside it; keep its price numeral in the same giant display serif as the other cards but in cream. ### Tier price block — Consistent oversized serif price treatment shared across all three cards. Each tier's price is a single very large display-serif numeral (~text-6xl, tabular-nums, tight leading) baseline-aligned with a small stacked caption to its right reading the currency on one line and the cadence ('/ mo, billed yearly') on the next in ~12px muted Inter; directly beneath, a small sub-note line (e.g. 'FREE, FOREVER' uppercase for the free tier, or '$288 billed once a year' / 'Per seat, 3 seats minimum' for paid tiers). ### Feature checklist — Per-tier 'includes / everything in X, plus' feature lists with accent-colored checks. Above each list, a small uppercase wide-tracked label ('INCLUDES', 'EVERYTHING IN SOLO, PLUS', 'EVERYTHING IN STUDIO, PLUS'). The list is vertically spaced rows, each a small bold checkmark icon (color-coded per tier: clay on Solo, terracotta on Studio, sage on Atelier) followed by a short Inter feature label in ~14px ink/75 (or cream/85 on the dark tier). Items top-align so multi-line labels read cleanly. ## Notas Especiais This is a frameless, fully responsive web page, not a fixed-size mockup: the pricing cards reflow 3 -> 2 -> 1 column (lg -> md -> mobile), the nav stays sticky and translucent with backdrop-blur, and several helper bits (center nav links, 'Sign in', the 'Save two months' note) hide on smaller breakpoints. The signature is the warm editorial palette + double-serif typography + the single inverted dark middle tier; keep saturation low and lean on whitespace and serif scale rather than color to feel premium. Annual is the default toggle state, and the dark middle tier is the intended conversion anchor.

style.description: Editorial, warm, and premium ('atelier'/old-money) rather than bright-SaaS. Low-saturation cream paper background with near-black 'ink' text, terracotta + clay + muted-sage accents, two serif families (a high-optical-size display serif for headlines/prices and a reading serif for descriptions) paired with Inter for UI/labels. Generous whitespace, very large display headings with tight leading, subtle radial-gradient 'grain' tint, hairline warm borders, large soft rounded cards (rounded-2xl), and pill-shaped buttons. The middle tier inverts to a solid dark 'ink' card with cream text for contrast.
